register_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C - Final Owner Decision Register & Handover Package

DEC-01.title: Select Prospective Market-Data Provider
DEC-01.current_proposal: Tiingo Starter/Power plan for pure daily EOD bar data; OR Alpaca Unlimited plan for paper-order execution mocking.
DEC-01.supporting_evidence: v30_stage2h_c_provider_decision_matrix.json confirms personal plans permit internal private algorithm modeling; pure data avoids Indian cross-border remittance complexity.
alternatives: Option A: Tiingo API (Recommended for pure data; $0-$30/mo; excellent split/dividend coverage)
Option B: Polygon.io / Massive Developer Plan ($29-$79/mo; CTA/UTP consolidated feed)
Option C: Alpaca Market Data ($9/mo; native paper execution)
Option D: Interactive Brokers TWS API (~$4.50/mo; complex LRS compliance)
DEC-01.risks: Vendor API downtime, rate limits, or potential exchange fee rule changes.
DEC-01.consequences: Selected provider dictates data ingestion adapter interface.
DEC-01.dependencies: Requires human owner to register account and obtain personal API key.
DEC-01.required_owner_action: Owner reviews provider terms and selects one provider.
DEC-01.approval_scope: Data provider selection only. Does not grant execution authority.

DEC-02.title: Approve Provider Rights and Retention Terms
DEC-02.current_proposal: Personal Non-Professional Subscriber Declaration with local caching restricted to single-user internal modeling; zero redistribution.
DEC-02.supporting_evidence: All evaluated vendor agreements strictly ban public redistribution or multi-user display under personal plans.
alternatives: Option A: Personal Non-Professional Agreement (Permitted for private internal research; zero external redistribution)
Option B: Commercial Redistribution License (Required if outputs or charts are published publicly)
DEC-02.risks: Exchange reclassification if owner trades on behalf of an institution or commercial entity.
DEC-02.consequences: Binds research to local single-user machine; forbids public website or dashboard deployment.
DEC-02.dependencies: Owner must qualify as Non-Professional under NYSE/NASDAQ/CTA rules.
DEC-02.required_owner_action: Owner signs Non-Professional declaration during vendor signup.
DEC-02.approval_scope: Legal licensing compliance for data storage and derived metrics.

DEC-03.title: Approve Primary Scientific Endpoint & Return-Cost Tolerance
DEC-03.current_proposal: Primary endpoint theta_def > 0 (paired downside shortfall reduction on defensive sessions) with secondary CAGR tolerance of -200 bps (D2 CAGR >= E0 CAGR - 2.0%).
DEC-03.supporting_evidence: v30_stage2h_c_scientific_evaluation_proposal.json provides full mathematical derivation and HAC variance formulas.
alternatives: Option A: theta_def > 0 with -200 bps annual CAGR margin (Recommended; reflects balanced insurance budget)
Option B: Defensive Sortino ratio superiority
Option C: Zero return drag tolerance (0 bps; requires D2 to never lag E0 in any regime)
DEC-03.risks: In a runaway bull market, D2's 50% cash cushion may lag E0 by more than 200 bps.
DEC-03.consequences: Locks the primary statistical test prior to prospective data collection.
DEC-03.dependencies: Requires owner concurrence with the 200 bps annual insurance cost budget.
DEC-03.required_owner_action: Owner ratifies theta_def formula and 200 bps return cost tolerance.

DEC-04.title: Approve Evaluation Horizon, Defensive Sample Size & Stopping Criteria
DEC-04.current_proposal: 252 prospective trading sessions horizon with minimum N_def = 30 sessions floor, with recommended contingent extension to N_def >= 45-60 if volatility is subdued; early stopping if D2 drawdown underperforms E0 by > 300 bps.
DEC-04.supporting_evidence: Power sensitivity in Gate E shows N=30 yields ~35% power for small effects; N>=45-60 achieves >80% power.
alternatives: Option A: 252 sessions with N_def >= 30 floor and contingent extension (Recommended)
Option B: Fixed 504 sessions (2 calendar years)
Option C: Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT) with continuous early stopping
DEC-04.risks: Prolonged low-volatility bull market may delay reaching N_def >= 30 defensive sessions.
DEC-04.consequences: Determines total elapsed time before conclusive scientific verdict can be rendered.
DEC-04.dependencies: Owner willingness to commit to a 1-year prospective observation window.
DEC-04.required_owner_action: Owner approves evaluation duration, extension policy, and stopping boundaries.
DEC-04.approval_scope: Sample size governance and early termination policy.

DEC-05.title: Approve Monitoring, Incident Response & Evidence Retention
DEC-05.current_proposal: 4-tier incident severity taxonomy (INFORMATIONAL, WARNING, CRITICAL, HARD STOP) with disk-persisted hard-stop lock requiring manual owner reset key.
alternatives: Option A: 4-tier taxonomy with persistent disk lock (Recommended)
DEC-05.risks: Hard-stop requires manual human intervention to clear after severe incidents.
DEC-05.consequences: Guarantees that operational or accounting anomalies cannot be bypassed by process restarts.
DEC-05.dependencies: Owner retention of the emergency manual reset key.
DEC-05.required_owner_action: Owner reviews and ratifies incident severity thresholds and persistent lock policy.
DEC-05.approval_scope: Site reliability and operational risk controls.

DEC-06.title: Separately Authorize Forward PAPER-ONLY Evaluation
DEC-06.current_proposal: Maintain frozen research state. Prospective paper evaluation remains strictly BLOCKED until DEC-01 through DEC-05 are formally resolved by owner.
DEC-06.supporting_evidence: All architectural, testing, accounting, and security prerequisites are satisfied (602/602 tests pass); activation is blocked purely by lack of human authorization.
alternatives: Option A: Maintain Frozen Research State (Recommended until owner resolves DEC-01 through DEC-05)
Option B: Issue Signed HMAC Token for Paper-Only Simulation (Requires owner secret key)
DEC-06.risks: Premature activation before provider or scientific endpoints are formally locked.
DEC-06.consequences: Guarantees zero unauthorized execution or simulation drift.
DEC-06.dependencies: Requires human owner to generate cryptographic HMAC token. NO TOKEN GENERATED BY AGENT.
DEC-06.required_owner_action: Owner generates signed token ONLY when ready to begin prospective evaluation.
DEC-06.approval_scope: Execution authorization for paper simulation only (Live trading permanently banned).
